verse.verse_2: No, but they marvel that from among themselves a warner has come to them. The unbelievers say (in mockery): 'This is a marvelous thing!
verse.verse_3: What, when we are dead and turned to dust? That indeed would be an unlikely return'
verse.verse_4: We know all that the earth takes away of them, and a Book of Records is with Us.
verse.verse_5: Rather, they belied the truth when it came to them, and now they are in a state of confusion.
verse.verse_6: What, have they never observed the heaven above them, (and seen) how We built and adorned it, leaving no crack?
verse.verse_7: We spread out the earth and set upon it firm mountains, and We cause every delightful thing to grow in it
verse.verse_8: as a lesson and a reminder to every penitent worshiper.
verse.verse_9: We sent down blessed water from the sky with which We caused gardens and the grains of harvest to grow,
verse.verse_10: and tall palmtrees with compact spathes
verse.verse_11: as a provision for the worshipers; thereby We revived a land that was dead. Such shall be the emerging.
verse.verse_12: Before them, the nation of Noah, the nation of ArRass belied and so did Thamood
verse.verse_13: and Aad, Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot,
verse.verse_14: the dwellers of the Thicket and the nation of Tubba', all belied their Messengers, therefore My threat was realized.
verse.verse_15: What, were We wearied by the first creation? No, indeed; yet they are in doubt about a new creation.
verse.verse_16: Indeed, We created the human. We know the whisperings of his soul, and are closer to him than the jugular vein.
verse.verse_17: When both receivers (the angels) receive, one on his right, the other on his left,
verse.verse_18: whatever phrase he utters, an observer is present.
verse.verse_19: And when the agony of death comes in truth (they will say): 'This is what you have been trying to avoid'
verse.verse_20: And the Horn shall be blown; that is the Day of Threat!
verse.verse_21: Each soul shall come with a driver, and a witness.
verse.verse_22: (It will be said): 'Of this you have been heedless. Therefore, we have now removed your covering. Today your sight is sharp'
verse.verse_23: And his companion will say: 'This is that which I have present'
verse.verse_24: (It will be said): 'Indeed, cast into Gehenna (Hell) every deviating unbeliever,
verse.verse_25: forbidder of good, transgressor and doubter,
verse.verse_26: who has set up with Allah another god. Indeed, you two, cast him into the terrible punishment'
verse.verse_27: And his companion shall say: 'Our Lord, I did not make him insolent, he was far astray'
verse.verse_28: He (Allah) will say: 'Do not dispute before Me. I sent you a warning beforehand.
verse.verse_29: The Word cannot be changed with Me; I do not wrong My worshipers'
verse.verse_30: On that Day We shall ask Gehenna: 'Are you full' And it will answer: 'Are there any more'
verse.verse_31: And Paradise, which is not far away, shall be brought closer to those who were cautious.
verse.verse_32: (It shall be said to them): 'This is that you were promised. It is for every heeding penitent.
verse.verse_33: Whosoever fears the Merciful in the Unseen, and comes with a contrite heart.
verse.verse_34: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity'
verse.verse_35: There they have all that they desire, and with Us is much more.
verse.verse_36: How many generations, stronger in might than they have We destroyed before them! They searched the land, could they find any asylum?
verse.verse_37: Surely, in this there is a Reminder for he who has a heart or listens attentively while witnessing.
verse.verse_38: In six days We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them and no weariness touched Us!
verse.verse_39: Bear then with patience what they say. Exalt with the praise of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset.
verse.verse_40: And exalt Him in the night, and at the ends of the prostrations.
verse.verse_41: Listen for the Day when the Caller will call from a nearby place.
verse.verse_42: On the Day when they will hear the Shout, in truth that Day they will emerge.
verse.verse_43: It is We who give life and make to die. To Us is the arrival.
verse.verse_44: Upon that Day the earth will be rent asunder from around them as they hurry forth that is an easy gathering for Us.
verse.verse_45: Indeed, We know what they say. You (Prophet Muhammad) are not a tyrant over them. Therefore, remind by the Koran whosoever fears (My) threat.
